description: This source file defines a custom JSP tag class ManufacturerImageUrlTag that generates a URL for a manufacturer's image based on various context attributes, configurations, and the merchant store's domain.

classes.name: ManufacturerImageUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that constructs and outputs a URL pointing to a manufacturer's image, considering store configuration and environment settings.

methods.description: Builds and writes the manufacturer image URL to the page output, handling configuration and context attributes.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Returns EVAL_PAGE to continue processing the JSP page after tag execution.

methods.description: Sets the imageName property for the tag.
